references.label: Side hit lanes
references.description: Upper side lanes that score doubles or triples and feed the bumper area.

references.label: Base saucers
references.description: Three center saucers that place a runner on first, second, or third base.

references.label: Home Run standups
references.description: Outside upper standups that become 5,000-point Home Runs with the bases loaded.

references.label: Top roto-target
references.description: Upper rotating target that can award points or a hit result.

references.label: Home Run outlanes
references.description: Drain lanes that award a Home Run as compensation.
